title: Agua de beber… - WANDAH DE SAH

lines.l: Your love is rain, my heart, the flower
I need your drink or I will die
My very life is in your power
Will I wither and fade or blossom to the sky
Água de bebê, água de bebê, Camara
Água de bebê, água de bebê, Camara
Eu quis amar, mas tive medo
Agua de bebe, Agua de bebe Camara
